content.short: VectorDAO is a creator DAO for application designers and developers working in Web3.
content.description: VectorDAO is a DAO made up of developers who have contributed to projects such as Coinbase, Marginfi, and Hashflow. Instead of cash payments for development work, VectorDAO takes equity in the projects they help build. As such, VectorDAO operates as a venture builder, creating promising projects in exchange for ownership stakes. If you are a project creator looking to outsource development, VectorDAO offers a compelling option to consider under its equity-based model.
